column1: # ESP-IDF Partition Table -- ESP-VoCat-S31 (16 MB flash)
# The current 360x360 Espressif emote bundle is about 2.7 MB and needs a
# dedicated read-only data partition. The boot splash is stored separately so
# the application can load it without enlarging the factory slot. Both data
# partitions below are sized from the current generated payloads with a small
# alignment margin; the recovered space is added to the factory slot. This build
# never performs an OTA update (it only reads esp_ota_get_running_partition()
